description: Synthetic items judged under the owner description saved on test-mac on 2026-10-29 whose fine-to-share clauses name things a default policy would hold Private (a child's appointments, friends' plans). From the 2026-10-29 test-mac case: a message about Leo's check-up was judged Private as health although the owner said his appointments are fine to share. Labels follow the owner's words. Material is shaped like production content material (Names, Excerpt).

privacyProfile.description:
Money and legal stuff are private, including anything from my lawyer or accountant. Plans with Leo, including his appointments, and plans with friends and my AI projects are fine to share.
About money: private — Bank, card, brokerage and crypto statements, Tax and payroll papers, Invoices, bills and receipts, Loans and proof of funds; fine to share — Articles and guides about money, Crypto project whitepapers and research, Prices and quotes I am researching.
